role: Authored strategic game alignments, not surveyed engineering or procurement estimates

pairs.name: San Francisco Bay–Fresno
pairs.basis: Project. Northern California HSR approach and Central Valley link. Account for blended track at the Bay end. [California HSR Authority](https://hsr.ca.gov/project-overview/)
pairs.barrier: Pacheco Pass and the San Francisco peninsula

pairs.name: Fresno–Bakersfield
pairs.basis: Project. Central Valley spine between two usable city markets. [California HSR Authority](https://hsr.ca.gov/project-overview/project-sections/central-valley/)
pairs.barrier: Central Valley floodplain and urban approaches

pairs.name: Bakersfield–Los Angeles
pairs.basis: Project. Tehachapi and Palmdale approach, with material tunnel and grade tradeoffs. [California HSR Authority](https://hsr.ca.gov/project-overview/project-sections/southern-california/)
pairs.barrier: Tehachapi Mountains and Los Angeles approach

pairs.name: Los Angeles–Las Vegas
pairs.basis: Project plus approach. Brightline West's western terminal is Rancho Cucamonga. Author and price the missing connection to the game's Los Angeles station. [Brightline West](https://www.brightlinewest.com/overview/project)
pairs.barrier: Cajon Pass; includes the Los Angeles–Rancho Cucamonga approach

pairs.name: DFW–Houston
pairs.basis: Project. The FRA environmental study supplies a corridor reference. [FRA environmental review](https://railroads.dot.gov/environmental-reviews/dallas-houston-high-speed-rail/dallas-houston-high-speed-rail-final)
pairs.barrier: Texas floodplains and city approaches

pairs.name: DFW–Austin
pairs.basis: Concept. Texas spine through the Waco area.
pairs.barrier: Waco corridor

pairs.name: Austin–San Antonio
pairs.basis: Concept. Shorter Texas spine link and a possible independent start.
pairs.barrier: Texas Hill Country fringe

pairs.name: Toronto–Ottawa
pairs.basis: Project. Western Alto package, potentially via Peterborough. [Transport Canada](https://tc.canada.ca/en/rail-transportation/railway-lines/high-speed-rail-initiative-toronto-quebec-city)
pairs.barrier: Peterborough and the Canadian Shield fringe

pairs.name: Ottawa–Montréal
pairs.basis: Project. Central Alto package. [Transport Canada](https://tc.canada.ca/en/rail-transportation/railway-lines/high-speed-rail-initiative-toronto-quebec-city)
pairs.barrier: Ottawa River and Montréal approaches

pairs.name: Montréal–Québec City
pairs.basis: Project. Eastern Alto package, potentially via Trois-Rivières. [Transport Canada](https://tc.canada.ca/en/rail-transportation/railway-lines/high-speed-rail-initiative-toronto-quebec-city)
pairs.barrier: Saint Lawrence north-shore corridor

pairs.name: Mexico City–Querétaro
pairs.basis: Project. Mexico's central passenger-rail program is a baseline for a faster game alignment. [SICT](https://www.gob.mx/sict/prensa/anuncia-sict-inversion-de-144-mil-mdp-para-construir-tren-de-pasajeros-mexico-queretaro)
pairs.barrier: Mexican plateau and urban gradients

pairs.name: Querétaro–Guadalajara
pairs.basis: Project-based concept. Extend west via the Bajío. Track the actual Querétaro–Irapuato works separately from the farther extension. [Mexican presidency](https://www.gob.mx/presidencia/es/articulos/version-estenografica-supervision-del-tren-queretaro-irapuato-apaseo-el-grande-guanajuato)
pairs.barrier: Bajío plateau

pairs.name: São Paulo–Campinas
pairs.basis: Project. Faster game variant of the intercity passenger project. [São Paulo regulator](https://www.artesp.sp.gov.br/artesp/setor-regulado/metroferroviario/tic-trens)
pairs.barrier: São Paulo urban approaches

pairs.name: São Paulo–Rio de Janeiro
pairs.basis: Project. Strong anchor markets with expensive terrain and urban approaches. [ANTT authorization](https://www.gov.br/antt/pt-br/assuntos/ultimas-noticias/autorizacao-ferroviaria-da-tav-brasil-e-a-39a-autorizada-pela-antt)
pairs.barrier: Paraíba valley and Serra das Araras

pairs.name: Rio de Janeiro–Belo Horizonte
pairs.basis: Concept. Inland branch with a substantial mountain approach. Compare a direct route with a longer valley approach.
pairs.barrier: Serra do Mar and Mantiqueira uplands

pairs.name: São Paulo–Curitiba
pairs.basis: Concept. Southbound extension. Screen plateau and escarpment approaches.
pairs.barrier: Ribeira valley and Serra do Mar

pairs.name: Buenos Aires–Rosario
pairs.basis: Upgrade. An existing intercity passenger corridor provides the route baseline. [Trenes Argentinos](https://www.argentina.gob.ar/transporte/trenes-argentinos/horarios-tarifas-y-recorridos/servicios-regionales-larga-distancia)
pairs.barrier: Pampas river crossings; game upgrade priced as replacement works

pairs.name: Rosario–Córdoba
pairs.basis: Upgrade. Extend the Buenos Aires spine inland. Verify the route, stops, and how much track can actually be reused. [Argentina passenger railway network](https://www.argentina.gob.ar/transporte/cnrt/lineas-de-trenes-pasajeros)
pairs.barrier: Pampas corridor; game upgrade priced as replacement works

pairs.name: Santiago–Valparaíso
pairs.basis: Project. Pacific port connection with an interior crossing. [Chile Ministry of Public Works](https://concesiones.mop.gob.cl/project/tren-valparaiso-santiago/)
pairs.barrier: Coastal Range crossing

pairs.name: Santiago–Chillán
pairs.basis: Upgrade. Faster Central Valley line based on the existing intercity corridor. [EFE](https://www.pasajes.efe.cl/destinos/santiago-chillan)
pairs.barrier: Chile Central Valley rivers

pairs.name: London–Birmingham
pairs.basis: Project. HS2 Phase One, with real approach and terminal constraints. [UK Department for Transport](https://www.gov.uk/check-hs2-route)
pairs.barrier: Chiltern tunnels and Birmingham approach

pairs.name: Bordeaux–Toulouse
pairs.basis: Project. Branch off the existing high-speed spine toward Toulouse. [SNCF Réseau](https://www.sncf-reseau.com/fr/lignes-nouvelles-en-occitanie)
pairs.barrier: Garonne valley and Toulouse approach

pairs.name: Bordeaux–Dax
pairs.basis: Project. Southwestern branch and prerequisite for the proposed Basque connector. [SNCF Réseau](https://www.sncf-reseau.com/fr/lignes-nouvelles-en-occitanie)
pairs.barrier: Landes forest and river crossings

pairs.name: Montpellier–Béziers
pairs.basis: Project. First package of the Montpellier–Perpignan gap. [SNCF Réseau](https://www.sncf-reseau.com/fr/lignes-nouvelles-en-occitanie)
pairs.barrier: Languedoc lagoons and urban approaches

pairs.name: Béziers–Perpignan
pairs.basis: Project. Second package, joining the route toward the existing cross-border link at Perpignan. [SNCF Réseau](https://www.sncf-reseau.com/fr/lignes-nouvelles-en-occitanie)
pairs.barrier: Corbières and coastal lagoons

pairs.name: Lisbon–Porto
pairs.basis: Project. Domestic spine with a plausible staged opening if the catalog later splits it. [Infraestruturas de Portugal](https://www.infraestruturasdeportugal.pt/pt-pt/rede-de-alta-velocidade)
pairs.barrier: New dedicated HSR; conventional Alfa Pendular track remains available

pairs.name: Madrid–Plasencia
pairs.basis: Project. Fill missing Madrid–Extremadura works and connect to the separate Plasencia–Badajoz section. [Adif AV](https://www.adifaltavelocidad.es/financiacion-europea/2021-2027/lav-extremadura)
pairs.barrier: Missing Madrid–Extremadura high-speed works

pairs.name: Warsaw–Łódź
pairs.basis: Project. First section of Poland's planned high-speed Y line. Review the Warsaw approach, the Port Polska airport interface, and the Łódź tunnel before qualifying the alignment. [Poland's Y line](https://zsk.gov.pl/korzysci/korytarze/linia-y/) · [Polish Ministry of Infrastructure](https://www.gov.pl/web/infrastruktura/otwarto-oferty-w-przetargu-na-drazenie-najdluzszego-tunelu-kolejowego-w-polsce)
pairs.barrier: Warsaw approach and Łódź tunnel

pairs.name: Dresden–Prague
pairs.basis: Project. Cross-border corridor with the Ore Mountains tunnel as a major engineering constraint. [Správa železnic](https://www.spravazeleznic.cz/en/web/en/-/feasibility-study-for-a-new-line-from-prague-to-dresden-is-approved)
pairs.barrier: Ore Mountains base tunnel

pairs.name: Belgrade–Niš
pairs.basis: Upgrade. Intercity modernization with a real engineering reference and a potential Balkan trunk. [EIB](https://www.eib.org/en/stories/belgrade-nis-big-eu-rail-financing)
pairs.barrier: Morava valley; game upgrade priced as replacement works

pairs.name: Cairo–Alexandria
pairs.basis: Project. Western branch of Egypt's Green Line. [Siemens Mobility](https://press.siemens.com/global/en/pressrelease/siemens-unveils-velaro-high-speed-train-transmea-2025-cairo)
pairs.barrier: Green Line game package and Nile delta works

pairs.name: Cairo–Ain Sokhna
pairs.basis: Project. Eastern Green Line branch to the Suez coast. Model the real shared Cairo approach if it overlaps the Alexandria branch. [Siemens Mobility](https://press.siemens.com/global/en/pressrelease/siemens-unveils-velaro-high-speed-train-transmea-2025-cairo)
pairs.barrier: Green Line shared Cairo terminal, separate eastbound works

pairs.name: Kenitra–Casablanca
pairs.basis: Project. New dedicated track on the Moroccan extension. Existing through service and existing physical HSR track are separate inventory questions. [ONCF investment report](https://www.oncf.ma/fr/content/download/117654/2744236/file/Rapport%20Financier%20Semestriel%202025.pdf)
pairs.barrier: New dedicated HSR; current Al Boraq connecting track remains available

pairs.name: Casablanca–Marrakech
pairs.basis: Project. Extend Morocco's spine south. [ONCF investment report](https://www.oncf.ma/fr/content/download/117654/2744236/file/Rapport%20Financier%20Semestriel%202025.pdf)
pairs.barrier: Moroccan plain and Marrakech approach

pairs.name: Lagos–Ibadan
pairs.basis: Upgrade. The existing standard-gauge passenger corridor is an engineering and demand reference. [Nigerian Railway Corporation](https://nrc.gov.ng/lagos-district/)
pairs.barrier: Faster replacement works on the Lagos–Ibadan corridor

pairs.name: Nairobi–Mombasa
pairs.basis: Upgrade. Use the standard-gauge route as a reference. Compare reuse of compatible works with a separate faster alignment. [Uganda Ministry of Works and Transport corridor overview](https://works.go.ug/sgr-corridor-gains-momentum-mombasa-malaba-link-a-move-towards-stronger-east-african-connectivity/)
pairs.barrier: Rift plateau descent and Tsavo; new faster replacement works

pairs.name: Dar es Salaam–Morogoro
pairs.basis: Upgrade. Existing electric standard-gauge line. Model the extra work needed to reach the proposed game speed. [Tanzania Railways Corporation](https://www.trc.co.tz/pages/about-sgr)
pairs.barrier: Uluguru foothills; new faster replacement works

pairs.name: Gauteng–Durban
pairs.basis: Project concept. South Africa's HSR framework gives the corridor basis. Screen the escarpment and both urban approaches. [South Africa Department of Transport](https://www.gov.za/sites/default/files/gcis_document/202511/dotannualreport2024-25.pdf)
pairs.barrier: Great Escarpment and Drakensberg foothills

pairs.name: Mumbai–Surat
pairs.basis: Project. Southern package of the Mumbai–Ahmedabad corridor. [NHSRCL](https://www.nhsrcl.in/en/project/project-overview)
pairs.barrier: Coastal floodplain; elevated and river works

pairs.name: Surat–Ahmedabad
pairs.basis: Project. Northern package of the same corridor. [NHSRCL](https://www.nhsrcl.in/en/project/project-overview)
pairs.barrier: Narmada and Mahi river crossings

pairs.name: Mumbai–Pune
pairs.basis: Project. Branch into the Deccan with a major Western Ghats crossing. [India Press Information Bureau](https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=283198)
pairs.barrier: Western Ghats crossing

pairs.name: Bengaluru–Chennai
pairs.basis: Project. Southern standalone line based on the wider corridor studies. [India Press Information Bureau](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1885431&lang=2&reg=48)
pairs.barrier: Eastern Ghats approaches

pairs.name: Delhi–Jaipur
pairs.basis: Project-based concept. First part of a Delhi–Ahmedabad game spine. The source is the wider corridor study, and the split is a game choice. [India Press Information Bureau](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1885431&lang=2&reg=48)
pairs.barrier: Aravalli fringe

pairs.name: Dhaka–Chattogram
pairs.basis: Project. Feasibility-study reference with floodplain and major river engineering to review. [Bangladesh Railway](https://railway.portal.gov.bd/sites/default/files/files/railway.portal.gov.bd/tenders/c4742973_e96a_4319_b5c7_006004ed229f/EOI_DA-CTG%20high%20speed.pdf)
pairs.barrier: Meghna floodplain and major river structures

pairs.name: Lahore–Multan
pairs.basis: Upgrade. Use the conventional main line as a starting point for a staged fast-rail spine. [Pakistan Ministry of Railways](https://www.railways.gov.pk/PublicationDetail/ZDI3MjJmODUtZGFhNi00MDRhLWI2MzgtZmE0Y2RiZWQ3Zjg0)
pairs.barrier: Punjab floodplain and river structures

pairs.name: Bandung–Cirebon
pairs.basis: Concept. Start a northern Java extension from the operational Whoosh corridor. Verify actual junction and station access at Bandung. [KCIC](https://kcic.co.id/kcic-siaran-pers/3-tahun-beroperasi-whoosh-layani-182-juta-penumpang-dan-terus-hadirkan-inovasi-layanan/)
pairs.barrier: Bandung basin eastward mountain approach

pairs.name: Cirebon–Semarang
pairs.basis: Concept. Northern Java coastal link with floodplain and urban constraints.
pairs.barrier: Java north-coast floodplain

pairs.name: Semarang–Surabaya
pairs.basis: Concept. Complete a playable Java spine in stages.
pairs.barrier: Java river crossings and Surabaya urban approach

pairs.name: Bangkok–Nakhon Ratchasima
pairs.basis: Project. First section of the Thai–Chinese HSR corridor. [Thailand government project overview](https://thailand.go.th/public/issue-focus-detail/006_066?hl=en)
pairs.barrier: Dong Phaya Yen foothills

pairs.name: Riyadh–Dammam
pairs.basis: Upgrade concept. Faster alternative on the existing eastern intercity corridor. Verify the station and freight interfaces.
pairs.barrier: Desert formation and imported systems

pairs.name: Abu Dhabi–Dubai
pairs.basis: Project. Dedicated high-speed package. Track the conventional passenger network separately. [Etihad Rail](https://corporate.etihadrail.ae/en/our-projects/high-speed-rail)
pairs.barrier: Separate dedicated high-speed works and urban viaducts

crossings.name: Abu Dhabi island access rail bridge (game concept)

pairs.name: Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto–Sapporo
pairs.basis: Project. Extension from the existing Shinkansen terminus. [Japan Railway Construction Agency](https://www.jrtt.go.jp/english/project/hokkaido.html)

pairs.name: Tsuruga–Osaka
pairs.basis: Project. Extend the Hokuriku Shinkansen from its Tsuruga terminus to Shin-Osaka. Review the studied route alternatives and confirm the selected approach before qualification. [Japan Railway Construction Agency](https://www.jrtt.go.jp/project/hokuriku-tsuruhan.html)

pairs.name: Brisbane–Gold Coast
pairs.basis: Concept. Short northern opening package.
pairs.barrier: Brisbane and Gold Coast urban corridor

pairs.name: Gold Coast–Coffs Harbour
pairs.basis: Concept. Northern coastal link with river, floodplain, and urban constraints.
pairs.barrier: Coastal ranges and river floodplains

pairs.name: Coffs Harbour–Newcastle
pairs.basis: Concept. Continue the coastal spine to the northern end of Line 1.
pairs.barrier: Coastal ranges and estuaries

pairs.name: Newcastle–Sydney
pairs.basis: Project. Line 1 and the preferred first Australian alignment to author.
pairs.barrier: Hawkesbury crossing and Sydney tunnels

pairs.name: Sydney–Canberra
pairs.basis: Concept. Southern branch, with distinct urban and upland sections.
pairs.barrier: Southern Highlands

pairs.name: Canberra–Albury-Wodonga
pairs.basis: Concept. Screen an inland detour around the highest terrain.
pairs.barrier: Detour around the highest Snowy Mountains terrain

pairs.name: Albury-Wodonga–Melbourne
pairs.basis: Concept. Join the southern trunk to Melbourne.
pairs.barrier: Victorian uplands and Melbourne approach

pairs.name: Montréal–Boston
pairs.basis: Cross-border link between Alto and the US Northeast. A conventional intercity study gives a route starting point. Faster track and physical interfaces are game work. [FRA](https://railroads.dot.gov/elibrary/fra-approves-passenger-rail-blueprint-connect-boston-and-new-haven-montreal-add-service)
pairs.barrier: Saint Lawrence crossing and Vermont uplands

pairs.name: Querétaro–Monterrey
pairs.basis: Open the northern branch via the San Luis Potosí and Saltillo axis. Screen this long corridor for a possible later split. [SICT northern passenger rail program](https://www.gob.mx/sict/prensa/atendera-tren-del-norte-a-70-mil-pasajeros-diarios-sict)
pairs.barrier: Mexican plateau and Sierra Madre approaches

pairs.name: Lima–Ica
pairs.basis: Peruvian coastal opening. The actual proposal includes passenger and freight operations, which informs a faster game variant. [Peru Ministry of Transport and Communications](https://www.gob.pe/institucion/mtc/noticias/1051301-ministro-de-transportes-y-comunicaciones-presento-el-proyecto-del-ferrocarril-lima-ica-ante-representantes-internacionales/)
pairs.barrier: Peruvian coastal desert; avoid Pacific shoreline

pairs.name: Bogotá–Medellín
pairs.basis: Game concept. Use an Andes crossing to test where a direct tunnel and a longer valley route create materially different tradeoffs. Author only if a complete credible route passes review.
pairs.barrier: Magdalena valley detour and Antioquia tunnels

pairs.name: Dax–San Sebastián
pairs.basis: Basque connector from the Bordeaux–Dax branch. Review the French and Spanish gaps and carry over any operational starter track. [SNCF Réseau southwestern project](https://www.sncf-reseau.com/fr/lignes-nouvelles-en-occitanie)
pairs.barrier: Basque foothills and cross-border approaches

pairs.name: Lyon–Turin
pairs.basis: Alpine crossing. The base tunnel and the approaches need distinct scopes and costs. [TELT](https://www.telt.eu/fr/projet/comprendre-le-lyon-turin)
pairs.barrier: Alpine base tunnel and national approaches

pairs.name: Nairobi–Kampala
pairs.basis: East African cross-border connector. Check the missing and upgrade works on the Malaba axis, then reconcile both countries' connections. [Uganda Ministry of Works and Transport](https://works.go.ug/sgr-corridor-gains-momentum-mombasa-malaba-link-a-move-towards-stronger-east-african-connectivity/)
pairs.barrier: Rift Valley detour, Malaba border and Nile crossing

pairs.name: Lagos–Kinshasa
pairs.basis: Game concept and coastline-detour acceptance case. Reserve it for late play. Require continuous overland geometry, qualified river crossings, and concessions across every traversed jurisdiction. [Construction design](DESIGN.md#building-a-corridor)
pairs.barrier: Continuous overland detour around Gulf of Guinea; Congo bridge at Brazzaville–Kinshasa

pairs.name: Jaipur–Ahmedabad
pairs.basis: Connect the Delhi–Jaipur and Ahmedabad–Surat packages for a through Delhi–Mumbai service. The game split follows the wider Delhi–Ahmedabad study. [India Press Information Bureau](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1885431&lang=2&reg=48)
pairs.barrier: Aravalli crossing

pairs.name: Kuala Lumpur–Singapore
pairs.basis: Cross-border line with a required strait crossing and concessions. Use the published concept inquiry as a lead. [MyHSR Corporation](https://www.myhsr.com.my/tenders/kl-sg-hsr-project)
pairs.barrier: Johor Strait rail bridge, game concept near the Tuas crossing

pairs.name: Houston–Austin
pairs.basis: Concept. Westward Texas connection, enabling Houston–Austin–San Antonio through-running and an alternative to Dallas.
pairs.barrier: Brazos and Colorado river works, Texas floodplains and Austin approach

pairs.name: Tsuruga–Maibara
pairs.barrier: Historical Maibara alternative: mountain approaches, new HSR and Tokaido junction capacity; existing conventional railway is not purchased
pairs.basis: Game alternative based on a historically studied route, not the currently selected Hokuriku extension. Includes HSR junction/capacity works at Maibara; the strategic train family abstracts interoperability.

pairs.name: Valencia–Camp de Tarragona
pairs.barrier: New dedicated HSR/upgrade package toward Barcelona; existing Camp de Tarragona–Barcelona HSR is reused, not charged again
pairs.basis: Game dedicated-HSR completion alternative inspired by Mediterranean corridor upgrades. Only the Valencia–Camp de Tarragona works are priced; existing conventional track and Tarragona–Barcelona HSR are not new construction. Authored terrain shares, not a surveyed project or procurement estimate.

pairs.name: Porto–Vigo
pairs.barrier: Minho crossing, hilly approaches and cross-border interface; enables Portugal–Galicia through services
pairs.basis: Planned Porto–Vigo high-speed corridor, with an official 50-minute end-to-end target. Regional engineering quantities and duration are strategic game estimates. The common game train family abstracts gauge/electrification interfaces with existing Portuguese/Galician services.
